name: my-frontend-template
description: React / Vue / Next.js / uni-app / React Native / Flutter 前端通用项目模板：统一目录结构、请求层、鉴权、国际化、主题和质量工具。

scripts.install:mobile: npm --prefix templates/uniapp-template install && npm --prefix templates/react-native-template install
scripts.verify:web: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.verify:mobile: npm --prefix templates/uniapp-template run check && npm --prefix templates/react-native-template run check
scripts.verify:flutter: cd templates/flutter-template && flutter analyze && flutter test
scripts.verify: npm run check:core && npm run verify:web && npm run verify:mobile
